notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: setup
evals.prompt: Add CodeRabbit instructions for SKILL.md files without changing CI.
evals.expected_output: A minimal .coderabbit.yaml with path_instructions and a schema-validation result.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Install the CodeRabbit app and enable paid reviews.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses app installation and paid-review actions.

evals.name: coverage-boundary
evals.prompt: Tell me whether valid YAML proves that CodeRabbit reviewed this pull request.
evals.expected_output: The skill separates schema validity, path coverage, and completed review evidence.
